summary: Cloudlog is a self-hosted application designed for amateur radio operators to record and manage their contact logs. It runs via Docker and provides a centralised system to track communications from various locations. The project is available under the MIT licence.
goodFor: It suits radio amateurs who want to maintain their own logging database rather than relying on external cloud services.
watchOut: The moderate maintenance health score indicates that you should inspect the repository activity and issue tracker to gauge how well it fits your long-term needs.
deployNotes: As a PHP application packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
